title: Rabbit Calicivirus Capsid Taqman RT-qPCR
author: Robyn Hall
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zkff4tn
materials: In a dedicated Mastermix hood, UV a 96 well qPCR plate and a Microseal B film for 30 minutes prior to use. Thaw reagents during this time. Prepare a 10 µM primer mix of GI.1 fwd; GI.1c_rev; GI.2 fwd; GI.2 rv; GI.1a fwd; GI.1a rv. Combine 10 µl of each primer stock (at 100 µM) with 40 µl of nuclease-free water. Prepare a Mastermix for number of required reactions + 7% extra to account for pipetting inaccuracies: A B 1 µl per reaction 2 Nuclease-free H2O 5 3 SensiFAST Probe No-ROX One-Step Mix (2x) 7.5 4 10µM primer mix 0.6 5 10µM GI.1c probe 0.15 6 10µM GI.2 probe 0.15 7 10µM GI.1a probe 0.15 8 RiboSafe RNase Inhibitor 0.15 9 Reverse transcriptase 0.3 10 Template RNA 1 11 TOTAL REACTION VOLUME 15 µl Preparation of Mastermix. Include 7% extra to account for pipetting inaccuracies. A B C 1 Name Sequence (5' - 3') Ref 2 GI.1 fwd TTCAGTTYTGGTAYGCCAATGCTG This study 3 GI.1c_rev AGGCCTGCACAGTCGTAACGTT Hall et al, 2018 4 GI.1c probe FAM - ATGTCGTTCGTACCCTTTAACGGCCCTG - BHQ1 This study 5 GI.2 fwd TGGAACTTGGCTTGAGTGTTGA Duarte et al, 2015 6 GI.2 rv ACGAGCGTGCTTGTGGACGG Duarte et al, 2015 7 GI.2 probe HEX - TGTCAGAACTTGTTGAYATYCGCCC - BHQ1 Duarte et al, 2015 8 GI.1a fwd AGTGCAAGTTWTKCTGGGAACAACT This study 9 GI.1a rv AAGCCTGYACAGTCGTAGCAGC This study 10 GI.1a probe TexasRed - ATGTCATTCGTGCCYTTTAACAGCCCCA - BHQ2 This study Primer and probe sets for rabbit calicivirus capsid TaqMan RT-qPCR Distribute 14 µl of Mastermix to each well of 96 well PCR plate. Add 1 µl of template to respective wells (in duplicate). - Ideally, this is done in a dedicated template addition area Seal plate with Microseal B film. Briefly spin plate down. Place plate in qPCR thermocycler (BioRad CFX96) and commence run. A B C 1 Temperature (°C) Duration 2 Reverse transcription 45 10 min 3 Initial denaturation 95 2 min 4 40 cycles of: 95 5 sec 5 63 20 sec Thermocycling conditions for rabbit calicivirus capsid TaqMan RT-qPCR

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Plate Layout
steps.instruction: Arrange samples and controls on the plate according to the specified layout, ensuring samples and controls are run in duplicate.

substeps.instruction: Include individual controls for each strain (GI.1, GI.2, GI.1a) or a pooled positive control

steps.title: Configure Instrument Baseline
steps.instruction: Set the baseline to 100 RFU for each fluorophore.

steps.title: Perform Quality Control Analysis
steps.instruction: Verify the run results against the following quality control criteria:

substeps.instruction: Confirm no amplification in any channel for NTCs
Confirm FAM signal is positive for GI.1 control only (or pooled positive)
Confirm HEX signal is positive for GI.2 control only (or pooled positive)
Confirm TexasRed signal is positive for GI.1a control only (or pooled positive)
Verify Cq of positive controls is within 0.5 Cq of previous runs
Verify Cq standard deviation is <0.5 between replicates
